text: We were __________ in the forest and made a fire to cook hot dogs.
I want to go __________ at the water park in Qiddiya City.
Naseer fell when he was __________ up a mountain.
Don't forget your __________, Saeed. It's cold in the forest at night.
Khadija is good at putting up a __________. She goes camping a lot.
Remember to pull your __________ out of the water when you finish.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'raft' تعني طوف أو قارب مطاطي.

text: We went horseback __________ this summer.
You need a __________ to see in the forest at night.
Fouad's __________ was heavy, so Mr. Hassan carried it.
We were sitting by the __________ to cook our food.
Maha __________ down when she __________.

explanation.A: صحيح! ماضي بسيط + ماضي مستمر: fell / was climbing.
explanation.C: ماضيين بسيطين لا يعبران عن التداخل الزمني.

explanation.A: صحيح! ماضي مستمر (حدث طويل) + ماضي بسيط (حدث مفاجئ).
explanation.B: خطأ: 'see' لا تستخدم عادة في المستمر.
explanation.D: جائز لكن 'were hiking / saw' أفضل لوصف المشهد.

text: Amal __________ cold while she __________ in the ocean.

explanation.C: ماضيين بسيطين لا يربطان الحدثين زمنياً.
explanation.D: جائز لكن 'felt / was surfing' أكثر دقة.

text: They __________ when the fire __________.

explanation.A: صحيح! نفي ماضي مستمر + ماضي بسيط.
explanation.B: خطأ: 'start' فعل لحظي لا يستخدم في المستمر عادة.
explanation.D: جائز لكن المستمر أفضل لوصف الحالة المستمرة قبل الحدث.

text: What __________ you __________ when the horse __________ away?

explanation.A: صحيح! سؤال ماضي مستمر + ماضي بسيط.
explanation.B: خطأ: السؤال بالماضي البسيط لا يناسب السياق.
explanation.C: خطأ: 'ran' فعل لحظي لا يستخدم في المستمر.
explanation.D: جائز لكن المستمر أفضل للسؤال عن نشاط مستمر.

text: __________ we were hiking, we made lots of new friends.
We saw a campfire __________ we arrived.
Did Noura wear a helmet __________ she was climbing?
Jabr didn't feel scared __________ he saw the bear.
__________ we were setting up the tent, we didn't talk.

On the first day, we (1) __________ for many hours before we found our campsite. (2) __________ the leaders were looking for wood, we set up our (3) __________. Then we made a (4) __________ and ate hot dogs. The night was cold, but I had my (5) __________ to keep me warm. In the morning, (6) __________ we woke up, the leaders (7) __________ our backpacks ready. We hiked for two hours and I (8) __________ tired. While we were canoeing, the leaders caught fish for us with their (9) __________. I (10) __________ expect it to taste so good.
options: Part 1: were hiking / hiked / was hiking / are hiking
Part 3: tents / backpacks / sleeping bags / rafts
Part 4: campfire / tent / flashlight / sleeping bag
Part 5: sleeping bag / tent / backpack / raft
Part 7: were getting / got / was getting / get
Part 8: was feeling / felt / feel / am feeling
Part 9: fishing rods / rafts / backpacks / helmets

explanation.A: الإجابات الصحيحة: 1. were hiking, 2. While, 3. tents, 4. campfire, 5. sleeping bag, 6. When, 7. were getting, 8. was feeling, 9. fishing rods, 10. didn't
